resources.string: No browser is available to open this link.
The dashboard closes and any robot camera view stops. Your Owner pairing on this phone is kept.
This is a Tailscale address. Open the Tailscale app on this phone, make sure it is connected to the same tailnet as the robot, then try again.
The phone could not look up the dashboard address. Check that the phone is online and that the address in Server settings is right.
The server address was found but did not respond. The robot may be off or restarting, or its HTTPS service may be stopped.
The server answered with an error, which usually means Homebody is restarting or updating. Wait a moment and try again.

The server\'s HTTPS certificate was not accepted, so Homebody did not connect. This app never ignores certificate errors and never falls back to unencrypted HTTP. For Tailscale Serve, use the full machine name ending in .ts.net and make sure HTTPS certificates are enabled for your tailnet.
The page tried to open something outside your Homebody server. Only the configured server is shown inside this app.
Android stopped the web page. Nothing was sent to the robot. Try again to reload it.
The dashboard could not be loaded. Check the phone\'s connection and the server address, then try again.

The HTTPS address of your robot\'s dashboard, for example https://robot.your-tailnet.ts.net/. Only this exact address (scheme, host and port) is opened inside the app; other links open in your browser after you tap them. Tailscale (.ts.net) addresses need the Tailscale app connected on this phone.
The address must start with https://. Unencrypted http is not supported.
Remove the user name or password (the part before @). Pairing happens in the dashboard instead.
Enter only the server, such as https://robot.example.ts.net/ — no path, ?query or #fragment.
The port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
The address contains spaces or characters that are not allowed. Enter international domain names in their xn-- form.
This is not a valid server address. Use a host name such as robot.example.ts.net or an IPv4 address.

Pair inside the dashboard with a one-time Owner code generated on the robot. The app stores no codes, tokens or passwords; the dashboard\'s own Owner cookie keeps this phone paired. To unpair, use Forget this device in the dashboard.
Clear sign-in and site data on this phone

This removes the Owner cookie and all dashboard data stored on this phone. You will need a new pairing code. It does not revoke the device on the robot; use Forget this device in the dashboard for that.
